name: Tell a Demon
source:
Tell a Demon is a visual novel set in a 1920s style fantasy world, centering around themes of love, loss, and vengeance. Influence the intertwining stories of three protagonists with your choices: Julius, who just wants to get his life back, Tell, a mortal girl who finds herself wrapped up in the affairs of demons, and Kalevel, an immortal demon herself who now finds her very existence endangered by an old, old enemy.

[From [url=http://sunlabyrinth.com/portfolio/tell-demon/]Sun Labyrinth[/url]]
